mechanism: Identify local highs/lows with centered rolling window_size; alternate extrema define Uptrend/Downtrend segments; collect duration (days), points, % change; report means and histograms by direction plus duration–magnitude scatter. Heavy right tail of magnitude distribution used to argue against grid averaging and for pyramiding along trend.
data_needed: OHLC history (EURUSD H1 example: 45k bars Feb 2018–May 2025); window_size (article uses 100 bars for mid/long trends); optional multi-TF runs D1/H4/H1/M30/M15.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 primary results; method also discussed for D1, H4, H1, M30, M15.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit empirical trend-regime sensor: typical hold horizon (~5 days / ~120 H1 bars), 100–200 pt modal move, and heavy-tail extreme-move frequency for risk/regime tagging.
quote: The average duration of the trend was 5.11 days... The average trend value, which is 167.37 points... majority of movements (51.59%) are in the range of 100-200 points.

mechanism: ACEEMD denoises financial series (preserve turning points; drop first IMF high-frequency noise) then distillation uses multi-head probabilistic attention: stratified uniform RandomKeys over sequence, QueryImportance+TopKQueries (~5·log N), AttentionOut only on selected queries, pool heads, transpose+conv upscale back to full length for residual Self-Attention and forecast head. Encoder stacks 3 distillation blocks then DMHAttention.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr multivariate state; OpenCL CNeuronMHProbAttention; batch-norm-with-noise; Actor–Director–Critic training (offline then online).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train 2024 random-policy samples; OOS Jan–Mar 2025 (13 trades).
why_new_for_mis: Sparse Top-K probabilistic attention over ACEEMD modes is a noise-robust sequence sensor that focuses on informative reversals/trends under high volatility without full quadratic attention.
quote: Particular attention is given to the first intrinsic mode function (IMF), whose explicit removal helps eliminate high-frequency noise... By selecting only the most informative features and Queries, the model achieves better generalization

mechanism: Over period N, cumulative path length R_k = sum |Δprice| from past→future, normalize by R_{N-1}, take logs of path and time, estimate exponent α and proportionality from log-log regression. α≈0 → weak change/flat; α=1 → linear trend; observed range ~0–2.5 used to justify recency-weighted smoothers.
data_needed: Close series; indicator period iPeriod≥3 (Wandering indicator).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex price series on MT5 (generic; EAs/indicators attached, no single pair locked).
why_new_for_mis: Single scalar path-scaling exponent is a lightweight continuous regime sensor distinguishing flat vs trending path geometry without discrete labels.
quote: If it is close to 0, this indicates a weak price change - a flat. For a linear trend, this indicator is equal to 1. The exponent varies over a very wide range from 0 to approximately 2.5.

mechanism: Model next price as current + error/increment; build empirical distribution of increments; discard smallest and largest Percent% tails; remaining band is a distribution-free forecast channel around the current price (no classical parametric assumption).
data_needed: Price increments over Duration bars; Percent trim 1–99 (Price Increments indicator).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Forex increments on chart TF (MT5 scripts/indicators).
why_new_for_mis: Empirical trimmed-increment envelope is a model-free short-horizon volatility/uncertainty channel MIS can attach without assuming Gaussian residuals.
quote: So, we have an empirical distribution of price increments. Let's discard the third of the smallest and largest increments. Then we will have a channel we can use to predict the future price value.

mechanism: Feature groups: price (EMA crosses etc.), time (hour/dow + sin/cos hour), volume (tick vol change, rel_volume). K-means (3 clusters/group) → discrete states (9 used); count transitions into P; separately count bullish next-candle rises into rise_probability_matrix; predict weighted P(rise|current_state) and confidence; accuracy rises with confidence bins.
data_needed: OHLCV + indicators; n_clusters_per_group=3; historical state sequence; transition and rise matrices; train/test split (80/20).
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable 9-state regime detector from price×calendar×volume clusters with transition and direction-rise sensors—directly usable MIS regime/change features with confidence.
quote: Market regime detection – automatic classification of the current market state as trending, sideways or transitional.... forecasts with high confidence (>70%) achieve accuracy of up to 68-70%

mechanism: Extract minute, hour, day-of-week, day-of-month, month, year; for each period T compute multi-frequency sin/cos harmonics with powers of two; OpenCL TSPositionEncoder adds harmonics on-the-fly to projected/normalized features from real timestamps (no lookup tables). Embeddings concatenated with Min-Max scaled series values.
data_needed: Per-bar timestamps in seconds; period array (calendar cycle lengths); freqs harmonics per period; projection+batch-norm before AddPE.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Framework for any instrument/TF; trading stack later uses EURUSD (series).
why_new_for_mis: True calendar-aware positional sensor (session/season/macro phase) vs index-only PE—MIS can condition other sensors on when an event occurs in market time.
quote: Timestamps, including minute, hour, day of the week, day of the month, month, and year, are extracted separately and converted into vector representations.... These vectors encode temporal dependencies across multiple scales

mechanism: Prior-data Fitted Networks: pretrain on millions of synthetic series (SDEs, hand patterns, random rules) with MSE+NLL+cross-entropy for regime-switch; Mamba SSM blocks with linear sequence cost; causal multi-window conv + inception; decode entire forecast horizon in one pass (optional log-variance head). Zero-shot on new assets/TFs without fine-tune.
data_needed: Synthetic PFN corpus; Min-Max scale; SSM A,B,C,D; LayerNorm; causal conv stack depth; multi-step decoder.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Designed for any asset/time scale; paper+framework aimed at trading deployment.
why_new_for_mis: Foundation zero-shot SSM forecast+regime-switch head gives MIS a transferable sequence sensor not locked to one symbol’s history.
quote: The model is trained simultaneously using multiple loss functions: Mean Squared Error (MSE), Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL), and cross-entropy loss for regime-switch prediction.

mechanism: CNeuronMultiWindowsConvWPadOCL / FeedForwardMultWinConvWPad: same input stream through parallel convolution windows of different lengths with zero padding so thread count stays equal; center-align windows; concat multi-scale activations then normalize into Mamba blocks. Captures local impulse and longer trend in one layer.
data_needed: Univariate/multivariate sequences; windows_in[] kernel sizes; shared step; window_out embedding dim; OpenCL Adam update kernels.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Mamba4Cast encoder components for financial TS (EURUSD in series tests later).
why_new_for_mis: Balanced multi-scale causal conv front-end is a reusable MIS feature sensor for simultaneous microstructure and trend context before SSM/attention.
quote: Multiple parallel convolutions with unique windows allow capturing different time scales. Each convolution captures information at certain levels: from local fluctuations to long-term trends.

mechanism: Daily close change vs 0.5×ATR(14) labels FLAT/UPTREND/DOWNTREND; build 3×3 transition matrix on rolling history (100 bars); flatten 9 probs → MLP (9-40-2) for buy/sell scores; retrain every 48h; optional 7-state ATR-normalized ladder. Diagonal dominance read as regime persistence.
data_needed: Symbol closes + iATR; transitionCounts; ALGLIB MLP; signal threshold 0.55; multi-TF barsPerDay mapping.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD and GBPUSD; PERIOD_CURRENT with D1 state detection; tests 2017–2025.
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-scaled discrete regime sensor whose transition fingerprint feeds a live neural head—MIS can track P(stay) vs P(switch) under changing ATR.
quote: we compare the daily price change with the ATR indicator, essentially normalizing price movements relative to current market volatility.... high values along the diagonal of the matrix... indicate a tendency for the market to maintain the current state

mechanism: Reimplements MQL5-like CAccountInfo/CSymbolInfo/COrderInfo/CPositionInfo/CDealInfo/CTerminalInfo/CTrade as Python classes over MetaTrader5 package for ergonomic order/account access and Intellisense—no market sensing model.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD examples for API demos only.
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing content after full read; execution/API convenience layer only.
quote: this article serves as the documentation of the trade classes for MetaTrader5 I made in the Python programming language

mechanism: Split any-length series into fixed N patches (e.g. 32); conv→mean-pool tokens; parallel first-difference stream; Multi-Scaled Scalar Encoder of per-window mean and std (level+volatility); concat+project; class token + Transformer; contrastive pretrain (RandomCropResize); temperature scaling for calibrated class probs; channel adapters (PCA/SVD/LComb) for multivariate.
data_needed: Univariate or adapted multivariate series; 32 patches×256; augmentations; temperature scalar; optional adapters.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: General TS classification; crypto flash-crash and tech-stock regime examples; trading implementation continues in later parts.
why_new_for_mis: Calibrated foundation classifier with explicit level/vol/diff streams and regime/anomaly labels is a ready MIS pattern/regime sensor with trustworthy confidence.
quote: In addition, two more types of information are extracted: scale and volatility.... the mean and standard deviation are calculated for each window.... temperature scaling module: it adjusts the output logits so that the posterior probabilities better reflect the empirical likelihood

mechanism: CNeuronMantisPatching: per-channel conv (win=3)→segment with patch_size→SoftPlus filters→max-pool over filters (vs authors’ mean-pool) into fixed tokens; CNeuronMantisAttentionUnit uses trainable class token as Query in channel-independent cross-attention over patch Keys/Values, SoftMax class probs; drops sinusoidal PE because Mamba4Cast temporal embedding already present.
data_needed: Multichannel T×C tensor after ConcatDiff+temporal embed; patchs, embedding_size, patch_filters; attention heads/layers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Building blocks for Mantis trading stack (EURUSD M1 in final part).
why_new_for_mis: Sharper max-pooled patch tokens plus cross-attention class aggregator yield a compact market-state embedding MIS can read as regime/pattern probabilities.
quote: Patches are localized segments of market behavior — essentially condensed mini-charts. They capture phases ranging from impulse / impulse moves and consolidations to pullbacks and divergences.

mechanism: MAPIE CrossConformalClassifier around RF (or any sklearn model): for each sample emit prediction set at confidence_level; meta_label=1 only if set size==1 (high confidence); optionally keep base labels only where predicted==true label; train CatBoost main+meta; Mondrian/APS/RAPS discussed for class-conditional coverage; threshold tunes trade count vs risk.
data_needed: Labeled features from prices; confidence_level (e.g. 0.9); cv folds; ONNX export; main/meta thresholds in MT5 EA.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD_H1; train ~2020–2025; forward after 2025-01-01; also stable 2017–2020 in tester.
why_new_for_mis: Distribution-free finite-sample confidence sets turn any classifier into an uncertainty/regime-ambiguity sensor—MIS can gate other signals when set size>1.
quote: Mark labels as "good" (1.0) only where prediction set size is exactly 1.... by adjusting the confidence level of the model, it is possible to control the risks associated with unsuccessful trading operations.

mechanism: Full Encoder: batch-norm+noise → ConcatDiff → Mamba4Cast temporal embed (H1+D1 periods) → multi-window conv → MantisPatching → MantisAttentionUnit class embedding; StudyContrast trains Encoder by noise-aug positive pairs and repulsive negative pairs on live EURUSD M1 history; embedding feeds Actor–Director–Critic.
data_needed: EURUSD M1 rates + RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD buffers; Start/End dates; Iterations/Batch; account features for Actor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; contrastive on ~5y; offline 2024; OOS Jan–Mar 2025 (881 trades, PF 1.25).
why_new_for_mis: Operational contrastive latent of patched multichannel market state is a deployable MIS regime/pattern embedding trained to separate similar-but-different market contexts.
quote: Mantis makes it possible not only to capture signals but also to identify market regimes.... Positive and negative pairs, generated through soft augmentation and controlled noise, enabled the model, in practice, to learn to see through market noise.
